profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Innovation Technology | Colorwave Alum
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer | Media Supply Chain, HBO Max & Max
profile.summary:
I’m a technical product-oriented leader with 7+ years of engineering experience, now focused on driving clarity, alignment, and execution across product and engineering teams.

🎮 Where it started:
My tech journey began in middle school at a summer gaming camp, where the thrill of creating something from scratch sparked a lifelong fascination with technology. Over the years, that spark evolved into a passion for building systems, tools, and experiences that solve real problems for real people.

🧩 How I work today:
I bring a hybrid approach that blends technical fluency, product thinking, and cross-functional leadership. I’ve worked across media, e-commerce, and tech, contributing to platforms ranging from ML-powered planning tools (SNKRS) to commercial content delivery systems. No matter the domain, my throughline has been the same: turn ambiguity into clarity, translate ideas into actionable plans, and guide teams toward meaningful outcomes.

🔎 What I do best:
1. Shaping MVPs and simplifying complex problems
2. Partnering with design, engineering, and product to define requirements
3. Identifying risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early
4. Creating structure in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
5. Keeping teams aligned, unblocked, and focused on impact

🌱 What I’m focusing on next:
I thrive in mission-driven startup environments where ownership is high, the problems are meaningful, and collaboration drives everything.

🤝 Let’s connect:
Whether you're working on early-stage products, ethical AI, or experience-driven technology, I’d love to connect. I'm passionate about inclusive tech, building thoughtful systems, and helping teams work smarter, not harder.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer | Media Supply Chain, HBO Max & Max
positions.description:
Led the cross-functional development of a new Ad Content tracking system, aligning engineering, product, and operations to support seamless receipt, management, and fulfillment of ads across all brands.

Technologies: React, Redux, Javascript, Node.js, Python, AWS, Jenkins, Git
Team Collaboration: Agile Methodology, Github, Jira, Figma

positions.title: Colorwave Fellow | Tech, Startups, VC
positions.description:
Colorwave’s mission is to help close America’s racial wealth gap by connecting underrepresented professionals with meaningful opportunities across the innovation economy.

Selected as one of just 56 fellows (19% acceptance rate) in the program’s most competitive selection cycle to date. Participated in a 9-week virtual fellowship designed to build community, foster professional growth, and create pathways into high-growth startups for underrepresented talent.

positions.title: Software Engineer | Global Pricing, Promos, & Markdowns
positions.description:
Led the creation of a global markdown price optimization UI, aligning engineering, product, and planning teams to enable faster in-season pricing decisions and drive revenue while supporting inventory health.

Technologies: React, Redux, AWS, PostgreSQL, Terraform, Jenkins, Git
Team Collaboration: Agile Methodology, Github, Jira, VersionOne, Figma, Miro

positions.title: Software Engineer | SNKRS, NIX, Tech Ops
positions.description:
Rotation 1: Supported the delivery of key enhancements to the Nike Inventory Exchange platform by partnering with engineering and DevOps to streamline UI updates, modernize backend services, and automate deployment workflows across AWS.

Rotation 2: Collaborated with product, data science, and engineering to deliver Launchpad, an ML-powered demand forecasting tool, by integrating UX, API, and data workflows that supported more accurate high-heat launch planning.

Rotation 3: Partnered with infrastructure, data, and platform teams to enhance ServiceNow incident workflows and streamline ETL processes, improving reliability and visibility across backup and WiFi operational systems.

Technologies: AngularJS, Javascript, Python, Java, NodeJS, Snowflake, SQL, Docker, Jupyter, AWS, Terraform, Jenkins, Jest, Git, Rundeck
Team Collaboration: Agile Methodology, Github, Bitbucket, Jira, VersionOne

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: Contributed to various innovation projects via Vue.js and Javascript

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern | Nike Zero, Employee Hub
positions.description:
Developed an environment duplicator system, using Python, for the Production and QA databases of the internal Nike Zero network. Implemented UI changes using Bootstrap, HTML, and CSS for a website about coaching opportunities for women. Created a Sharepoint site and 15 architecture diagrams for internal applications used by employees.

Technologies: Python, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Amazon Alexa, Sharepoint

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Intelligent Vision and Automation Lab – Vision-based Egocentric Control of a Robot Arm
			
Georgia Institute of Technology ORS Research Program
Professor – Dr. Patricio Vela, PhD Mentor – Fu-Jen Chu

Examined human-robot interaction and vision algorithms for object detection/recognition. Developed MATLAB code to test the accuracy of the vision algorithms with testing and training images. Implemented MATLAB code that uses color thresholding to detect an object in an image and create the 3D point cloud figure of the object.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Athena Lab – Sense for Cents: Low-cost Distributed Wireless Humidity and Temperature Monitoring 
		
Georgia Institute of Technology ORS Research Program
Professor – Dr. Manos Tenzeris, PhD Mentor – John Kimionis

Aided a team of 4 members with creating a template for an inkjet-printed capacitor on Kapton substrate. Implemented Arduino code to integrate a capacitor with a microcontroller to detect temperature and humidity. Exposed to microcontrollers (TI MSP432P401R LaunchPad) with Energia and CCS interfaces.

positions.title: Network Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed a Remote Site Simulation Service that allows 1000+ users to conduct network reliability tests for ExxonMobil IT applications. Created a virtual machine portal with Virtual Machine Manager Console 2012 to host the tests for the simulation service. Conducted network reliability tests with a network emulator device using the Remote Site Simulation Service. Improved the network reliability testing process for the IT applications.

positions.title: Project Management Intern
positions.description: Headed and analyzed the usage of a new application that kept track of employees’ schedules and deliverables. Assisted the Project Manager, System Architects, Functional Analysts, Testers, and Customer Representatives in the planning, development and testing activities of the new block point technology release. Maintained LEAN Chart and Schedule Checklist for block point release. Conducted small meetings with 15 people and large meetings with ~70 people on the development of the block point release. Created a New Hire Information document that was used for the upcoming new hires.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Spelbots Robotics Lab - Robotics as a Tool of Engagement for Middle School Girls				

Spelman College EDGE (Enhancing Diversity in Graduate Education) Research Program
Professor – Dr. Yolanda Rankin	

Established a robotics and computer science curriculum that incorporated NXT Lego Mindstorms robots. Led the ISCS Robotics summer camp with ~25 girls and implemented the curriculum successfully. Presented at Tapia Conference 2014 in Seattle, WA.

volunteerExperiences.description: Cool Girls Club is a weekly after-school program dedicated to developing life skills and providing academic support for middle-school girls. I help educate participants on important topics that impact their lives, including puberty, self-esteem, conflict resolution, and STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math) exploration. Each week, we engage in interactive lessons that empower girls to thrive both academically and personally.

projects.title: DE&I University Recruitment
projects.description:
We implemented an innovative recruitment strategy aimed at attracting diverse talent from key Nike Tech universities. By partnering with student organizations that support underrepresented minorities and women in tech, we created an inclusive outreach approach. 

This included collaborating with Nike Trainers to host an engaging workout session, followed by an informative Q&A where prospective interns could learn about life at Nike and the internship program. This laid-back setting allowed us to connect personally with candidates, culminating in one-on-one conversations to delve deeper into their backgrounds and aspirations. 

As a result, we collected over 100 resumes, which we carefully reviewed to identify the best candidates based on their qualifications and our conversations. Ultimately, two outstanding individuals were selected to intern at Nike as a result of this strategy.
